tool.name: LiteLLM
tool.summary: Universal proxy and Python SDK to call 100+ LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex, Ollama, Groq) using the standard OpenAI format with load balancing and fallbacks.
tool.architecture: Unified API gateway proxy and translation layer.
tool.usage:
from litellm import completion
response = completion(
    model="anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello World"}]
)
tool.benchmarks: 99.99% gateway reliability with automatic multi-provider failover routing.
tool.limitations: Gateway proxy adds slight network hop (~5ms) in high-throughput setups.
